parameters.name: Enable
parameters.description: MUST be enabled to receive UDP echo. When enabled from a disabled state all related timestamps, statistics and UDP Echo Plus counters are cleared.

parameters.name: Interface
parameters.description: {{reference|IP-layer interface over which the CPE MUST listen and receive UDP echo requests on}} The value of this parameter MUST be either a valid interface or {{empty}}. An attempt to set this parameter to a different value MUST be rejected as an invalid parameter value. If {{empty}} is specified, the CPE MUST listen and receive UDP echo requests on all interfaces. Note: Interfaces behind a NAT MAY require port forwarding rules configured in the Gateway to enable receiving the UDP packets.

parameters.name: SourceIPAddress
parameters.description: The Source IP address of the UDP echo packet. The CPE MUST only respond to a UDP echo from this source IP address.

parameters.name: UDPPort
parameters.description: The UDP port on which the UDP server MUST listen and respond to UDP echo requests.

parameters.name: EchoPlusEnabled
parameters.description: If {{true}} the CPE will perform necessary packet processing for UDP Echo Plus packets.

parameters.name: EchoPlusSupported
parameters.description: {{true}} if UDP Echo Plus is supported.

parameters.name: PacketsReceived
parameters.description: Incremented upon each valid UDP echo packet received.

parameters.name: PacketsResponded
parameters.description: Incremented for each UDP echo response sent.

parameters.name: BytesReceived
parameters.description: The number of UDP received bytes including payload and UDP header after the UDPEchoConfig is enabled.

parameters.name: BytesResponded
parameters.description: The number of UDP responded bytes, including payload and UDP header sent after the UDPEchoConfig is enabled.

parameters.name: TimeFirstPacketReceived
parameters.description: Time in UTC, which MUST be specified to microsecond precision. For example: 2008-04-09T15:01:05.123456, The time that the server receives the first UDP echo packet after the UDPEchoConfig is enabled.

parameters.name: TimeLastPacketReceived
parameters.description: Time in UTC, which MUST be specified to microsecond precision. For example: 2008-04-09T15:01:05.123456 The time that the server receives the most recent UDP echo packet.

object.description: This object allows the CPE to be configured to perform the UDP Echo Service defined in {{bibref|RFC862}} and UDP Echo Plus Service defined in {{bibref|TR-143|Appendix A.1}}.
